newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Mexlub says to issue $70 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Mexlub says to issue $70 mln bonds.

text.p: Lubricant Mexicana de Lubricantes (Mexlub) will issue convertible bonds for $70 million, the company president told reporters late Thursday.

"We are doing preparatory work to seek to raise capital through a foreign institutional investor.... They will be bonds convertible into L series shares, with limited voting rights, but at a given time we could buy them back in five years," said Mexlub President Salvador Martinez Garza.
"The first amount of capital raised will be for $70 million," he added.
Mexlub was created in 1993 by state oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) and Impulsora Jalisciense. Pemex holds a 49-percent stake in Mexlub.
